svp-team-pace-sr.label: PBKS strike rate against pace, 2022–2026
svp-team-pace-sr.query: SELECT CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (7,12) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_t, bw.name bowler, d.batter_runs r, CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END b, CASE WHEN dm.player_out_id = d.batter_id AND dm.kind NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','retired out','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END w FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players bw ON bw.player_id = d.bowler_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2022
